hook: AI could break encryption before quantum does.

beats.say: A new danger captured attention this week: AI labs might unleash an ultimate decryption event, factoring the huge numbers that guard our data.
Classic RSA security rests on multiplying two big primes into a figure of two thousand forty-eight bits, about six hundred seventeen decimal digits.
The FT argues for faster upgrades to security, not panic, and for disclosing, verifying and discussing any breakthrough openly.
